marking_points.text: (thermal) energy per unit mass (to change temperature)
(thermal) energy per unit change in temperature

Any three bulleted points from: • the blocks end up in thermal equilibrium • heat capacity of Y is larger than heat capacity of X • no heat loss to the surroundings Up to 2 points from these six: • initial temperature of X = 85 °C • initial temperature of Y = 25 °C • the temperature change of X = 45 °C • the temperature change of Y = 15 °C • the temperature change in X is three times that in Y • final temperature of both = 40 °C
Δθ = 45 °C for X and 15 °C for Y
